slowQuery.resetStatsConfirmTitle: Reset all slow query statistics? This clears every operation's slow query counters and alert statistics (they restart from zero) and cannot be undone.
slowQuery.filterEmptyDescription: No slow query records match the current filters. Loosen the conditions or clear the filters.
slowQuery.noDataEmptyDescription: No slow queries were recorded in this collection window. Refresh later or check the slow query threshold configuration.
slowQuery.noHotspotsEmptyDescription: No performance hotspots to display in the current collection window. Adjust the top-N limit and retry.
slowQuery.loadFailedDescription: The slow query analysis API returned an error. Please make sure the backend SlowQueryAnalysisController is ready.
slowQuery.noDataAlertDescription: No slow query records were detected in the system. Please refresh later or check the monitoring configuration.
